description: This file defines the class MessageOnlyLogFilter, which implements the LogNode interface. It filters log messages to only pass the message content without metadata, useful for simplified on-screen logging.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A filter class implementing LogNode, that only passes the message part of logs downstream.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor, takes a LogNode to chain to or creates an object with no next node.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method that receives log data, filters it by passing only the message string to the next LogNode.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
